Paragraph: Therefore the doubts which have arisen in your heart out of ignorance should be slashed by the weapon of knowledge. Armed with yoga, O Bharata, stand and fight.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Arjuna's internal conflict, hesitation, and emotional paralysis stemming from ignorance on the eve of duty.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'Therefore the doubts which have arisen in your heart out of ignorance should be slashed by the weapon of knowledge. Armed with yoga, O Bharata, stand and fight.'
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna is urged to use spiritual wisdom to destroy doubt, embrace self-discipline, and courageously execute his duty.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Decisive Action: Severing hesitation with clear reasoning to take prompt, purposeful action
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Confronting Paralysis: Overcoming mental avoidance by directly targeting the ignorance causing it
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Courage under Pressure: Standing firm to fulfill responsibilities despite challenging circumstances

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Ajnana-sambhutam hrt-stham (Doubts arisen in the heart born of ignorance)
Jnanasinatmannah chittvainam (Cutting doubts down with the sword of knowledge)
Yogam atisthottistha (Take shelter of yoga/self-discipline and arise)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Krishna commands Arjuna to cut down ignorance-born doubt with the sword of knowledge, take refuge in yoga, and rise to fulfill his duty.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Overcoming internal doubt through clear wisdom enables individuals to conquer paralysis and face life's battles head-on.
